conditions.description: Identical network and seed without external current injection.
Constant current 50.0 injected into the registered input neuron every tick.

seed_strategy.rule: Same frozen configuration, independent deterministic seeds, both conditions for every seed.

stopping_rule: Complete 100000 ticks for both conditions and all 10 seeds; stop only on runtime failure, non-finite state, or contract violation and record the failure.
inclusion_criteria: 10000 tick burn-in excluded from primary stability statistics
complete spike-per-tick and window traces retained
clean frozen code and configuration provenance
exclusion_criteria: runtime error or incomplete tick budget
unexpected neuron or synapse count change
missing raw trace or seed/condition record
dirty source tree or unreviewed protocol amendment

descriptive_statistics: per-window spike count mean and variation
final membrane and synaptic weight bounds
analysis_plan.inference_policy: A confirmatory pass requires every registered run to satisfy execution, finiteness and topology criteria and the tonic-drive condition to satisfy all preregistered stability thresholds. A failed criterion is a negative result, not an omitted run.

ai_treatment.authority_boundary: AI may summarize completed raw results but cannot select seeds, alter thresholds, exclude runs, or promote evidence.
